ITEM 1 | Bright red, moist, juicy fruit flesh cut into irregular wedges and chunks about 2–5 cm long and 1–2 cm thick, with a soft, slightly glossy surface and no visible cooking, scattered across the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Pale orange-tan firm cubes and angular chunks about 1.5–2.5 cm, matte to slightly sheened, with clean cut faces and no browning, sitting loosely on the plate | 90
ITEM 3 | Small whole dark blue-black berries about 1.2–1.5 cm across, glossy skins, seven visible, scattered among the red and orange pieces | 12
ITEM 4 | Small light-brown dry crumbs and specks, a few millimetres each, scattered near the upper edge and along the lower right of the plate | 2
